blueprint.name: Expense Submission & Approval System
blueprint.description: Expense Submission & Approval System for Employees and Managers

requirements.name: User Authentication
requirements.description: Employees, managers, and finance staff must be authenticated before submitting/reviewing expenses.

requirements.name: Expense Submission
requirements.description: Employees can submit expense reports with details such as amount, date, and receipt.
requirements.verification_method: Manual testing and user acceptance testing

requirements.name: Expense Review
requirements.description: Managers and finance staff can view and approve/reject expense reports.
requirements.verification_method: Manual testing and user acceptance testing

requirements.name: Approval Audit Trail
requirements.description: An audit trail must be maintained for all expense approval actions.
requirements.measurable_target: 100% coverage of audit trail for the past 3 months

requirements.name: Receipt Access Control
requirements.description: Managers and finance staff must have access to receipts for expense reports.

requirements.name: Amount Limit Policy
requirements.description: There should be a policy and interface for managing and applying expense amount limits by organization and manager roles.

requirements.name: Self-Approval Rejection Test
requirements.description: Employees should be able to re-approve their own rejected expense reports.
requirements.verification_method: Manual testing and user acceptance testing

non_functional_requirements.name: Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must handle 100 expense submisions and approvals per second without downtime.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_target: 100% uptime and response time below 2 seconds

non_functional_requirements.name: Scalability
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must be able to scale to support 10,000 concurrent users.

non_functional_requirements.name: Security
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must provide robust security to protect user data and prevent unauthorized access.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_target: No unauthorized access within the last 6 months

components.name: Authentication & Authorization Service
components.description: Handles user authentication, authorization, and session management.

components.name: Rate-Limiting Middleware
components.description: Limits API requests to prevent abuse and DDoS attacks.

components.name: Expense Submission Service
components.description: Handles the creation, storage, and validation of expense reports.

components.name: Expense Review Service
components.description: Handles the review and approval of expense reports.

components.name: Approval Audit Trail Service
components.description: Maintains and stores an audit trail of expense approval actions.

components.name: Receipt Access Control Service
components.description: Controls access to expense receipts based on user roles.

components.name: Amount Limit Policy Management Service
components.description: Manages and applies expense amount limits based on organization and manager roles.

data_models.name: User
data_models.description: Represents a user in the system.
